topic: Changes in Materials Due to Heat and Oxygen
key_concepts: Heat is a form of energy transferred between objects of different temperature.
Temperature is the hotness or coldness of an object and is measured with a thermometer.
When heat is added, molecules and atoms vibrate faster and the space between atoms increas
Solids, liquids, and gases expand when heat is added.
Heat can cause physical changes such as melting, evaporation, and drying without forming a
Heat can cause chemical changes that are irreversible and form a new material.
Oxygen is a reactive gas that can combine with many materials to form oxides.
Exposure to oxygen causes browning in eggplant, potato, banana, guava, and cassava.
Browning in vegetables can be prevented by placing them in salt water to block oxygen.
Combustion occurs when oxygen combines with a fuel and produces fire with heat and light.
Lack of oxygen in ponds or bodies of water can cause fish kill.
